description:
Debug Network Faster & Smarter with Proxyman

Proxyman is a high-performance Windows app, which enables developers to capture, inspect, and manipulate HTTP/HTTPS requests/responses with ease.
✨ Features
- Android emulator setup: Proxyman can now use Magisk to root your Play Store Android Emulator, so you can intercept traffic from it.
- Leaf certificate expiry: You can now choose how long generated HTTPS certificates stay valid.

⚡️ Improve
- Settings has a new design and search, so options are easier to find.
